clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge, Essential Artificial parts remain vital to gnomish tinkers and engineers rebuilding from exile. Stockpiles were left behind when the gnomes fled Gnomeregan.

Before Gnomeregan fell, tinkers called the Essential Artificial a nigh-universal component. Gnomish engineers fitted it into countless contraptions, clockwork wonders, and heavy machinery throughout the subterranean halls. Its standardized design gave smiths and machinists reliable parts they could interchange.

The trogg invasion and radiation disaster drove the gnomes from Gnomeregan in a desperate rush. Large reserves of Essential Artificial parts stayed behind in heavy, steam-powered dispensers called artificial extrapolators, scattered through the deeper passages. In Tinker Town, master craftsman Klockmort Spannerspan actively recruits daring adventurers to return to the contaminated ruins and salvage the parts, so research and invention can continue.
